clue.text: None but the elite runners break a leg

definitions.meaning: a field made up only of the finest competitors
the theatrical way of wishing someone good luck

explanation.surface: Only top athletes are racing, and someone wishes them luck before the start.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase works literally as every top performer and idiomatically as a good-luck farewell.

clue.text: Bend tree that's lacking length

indicators.note: lacking means the tree's name goes without one of its letters

parts.note: the larch is a conifer

explanation.surface: A tree with a short trunk is bending over.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to bend the back is to curve it in a bow shape.

clue.text: Discussed money for old instrument

indicators.note: something discussed is spoken, so the clue wants a word that sounds like the next one

parts.note: loot is slang for money, especially stolen money

explanation.surface: Someone talked about the price of an antique instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: The plucked stringed instrument of Renaissance music is the classic example of an early instrument.

clue.text: Sky is where it is, for pity's sake!

definitions.meaning: the firmament sits overhead, so the phrase literally locates the sky
an exclamation of exasperation or surprise

explanation.surface: Someone exasperatedly points out that the sky is obviously up there.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase literally places the firmament overhead and is also an old-fashioned exclamation of surprise.

clue.text: Chest in which devil locks preacher, ultimately

indicators.note: locks means the devil's word holds the next letter shut inside it

parts.note: the Beast is a name for the devil in Revelation

indicators.note: ultimately means only the final letter of the preacher is used

explanation.surface: A sermon image of a chest in which the devil traps a minister.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: the front of the upper body, the thorax, is also called the bosom.

clue.text: Bowlers the tops?

definitions.meaning: in cricket, bowlers who turn the ball off the pitch
toys that whirl on a point; the question mark flags the playful sense

explanation.surface: A question asking whether the bowlers are the best in the side.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bowlers' suggests hats and 'the tops' praise. In cricket a slow bowler who turns the ball is a spinner, and a spinning top is a toy that whirls on its point.
explanation.definitionFit: Slow cricket bowlers are named for the spin they impart, and whirling toy tops are also named for spinning.

clue.text: Jazz singing that's musical, back to front

indicators.note: back to front means the final letter of the show's title goes to the start

parts.note: Cats is the Lloyd Webber musical

explanation.surface: A jazz vocal turn that is musically reversed.
explanation.definitionFit: Improvised vocalising with nonsense syllables is a jazz style made famous by Ella Fitzgerald.

clue.text: Two animals in willow on the field?

definitions.meaning: an insect that chirps followed by a flying mammal
the willow implement used on a cricket pitch

explanation.surface: A pair of creatures hiding in a willow tree in a meadow.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer splits into two creatures, an insect and a flying mammal; as a whole it is the willow piece of kit carried onto a cricket field.
explanation.definitionFit: Cricket's striking implement is traditionally made from willow wood and used on the field of play.

clue.text: Death etc portrayed finally in destruction of star actor

indicators.note: in means that last letter goes inside the rearranged letters
destruction of means the letters of star actor are broken up and rebuilt
finally means the last letter of portrayed

explanation.surface: A dramatic death scene in which a famous actor is brought down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Death' looks like a stage death; it is one card of the major arcana. 'Destruction of' rearranges STAR ACTOR to TAROTCARS, and D goes 'in'.
explanation.definitionFit: Death is one of the major arcana in a fortune-telling deck, so Death and others are examples of the deck.

clue.text: Traditional dish — price regularly on the house?

indicators.note: on means one piece is placed after the other in this across clue

parts.note: a cottage is a small house

indicators.note: regularly means every other letter of price, starting with the first

explanation.surface: A restaurant offering a classic dish free, on the house.
explanation.walkthrough: 'On the house' reads as free; here 'on' places the pick after the dwelling word.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: minced meat topped with mashed potato is a classic British home-cooked meal.

clue.text: False witness found entering Mali, arrested

indicators.note: entering means the letters sit inside the words that follow, across the gap

explanation.surface: A perjurer turns up in Mali and is taken into custody.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: someone bearing false witness tells untruths, which is what a fibber does.

clue.text: Saddened by failure, released from employment?

definitions.meaning: let down because hopes were not met
read as dis- plus a word for hired, it means un-hired; the question mark flags the play

explanation.surface: Someone sacked from their job feels let down.
explanation.walkthrough: The second reading splits the answer as DIS plus a word for given a post, so it means having one's job taken away.
explanation.definitionFit: Let down by unmet hopes is the usual sense; taken literally it means stripped of a post.

clue.text: Number of passes in test OK, case under review

indicators.note: under review means the letters are reconsidered and set in a new order

explanation.surface: A cricket Test match where many passes are bowled and a case is being reviewed by the umpire.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Passes' suggests football or cricket play; here it means travel permits.
explanation.definitionFit: A long-term travel pass covering many journeys or events is one ticket counting as many passes.

clue.text: Work's nifty after breaking for a short rest

indicators.note: after breaking means the words are broken up and their letters reordered

explanation.surface: After a smart bit of work, someone takes a break.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: the phrase is the everyday name for a brief nap or snooze.

clue.text: Pudding to partake of, fragrant thing

parts.note: afters is British slang for dessert
to have food is to partake of it

explanation.surface: Someone invites you to eat a sweet-smelling dessert.
explanation.walkthrough: AFTERS is the British informal word for the dessert course.
explanation.definitionFit: A scented lotion splashed on after shaving is a fragrant product.

clue.text: Love a swimmer appearing stupid

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, written as O
a fish is a creature that swims

explanation.surface: A sweetheart looks foolish in the water.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: clumsy and doltish behaviour is foolish.

clue.text: Dash of milk goes in to make a meal

indicators.note: goes in means the picked letter is placed inside the word for make

parts.note: to create is to make

indicators.note: a dash of milk is just a drop, so only its first letter

explanation.surface: A splash of milk is added in preparing a meal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dash of milk' and 'meal' paint the answer itself, but the cream is not the cream: only M is taken, inside CREATE, then A.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: scones with jam and clotted cream plus a pot of tea make a British afternoon meal.

clue.text: Reptile burying head of prey in the earth

indicators.note: burying means the ground word holds the next letter inside it

parts.note: terrain is the ground or land

indicators.note: head of means the first letter of prey

explanation.surface: A reptile buries its catch in the ground.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a freshwater turtle is a kind of reptile.

clue.text: Singers incorporating a thousand quavers

indicators.note: incorporating means the singers' word takes the next letter into itself

parts.note: trebles are boy sopranos
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand

explanation.surface: A choir sings a thousand musical notes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Quavers' looks like the musical note; here it is a verb meaning shakes.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a voice that quavers shakes or quivers.

clue.text: In Urdu oddly, map showing hilly area

indicators.note: In means the map word goes inside the picked letters
oddly means the first and third letters of Urdu

parts.note: a plan is a map or diagram

explanation.surface: A map with an Urdu legend shows hill country.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: high ground or a plateau is elevated, hilly country.

clue.text: Alcohol taster, we hear?

indicators.note: we hear means the clue wants a word that sounds like the one before

parts.note: a licker tastes things with the tongue

explanation.surface: A wine taster is asked about spirits.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: strong drink or spirits.

clue.text: US state was riveting, I gathered

indicators.note: gathered means the letters are collected up and reassembled

explanation.surface: Someone reports, with their own impression, that it was gripping.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the Mountain State in Appalachia is one of the fifty American states.

clue.text: Right time to regret

parts.note: to rue is to regret

explanation.surface: Now is the proper moment for remorse.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: correct or accurate, as in a true answer.

clue.text: Firstly, every day I'm trying to change

indicators.note: Firstly means the opening letter of each of the following words

explanation.surface: Someone vows to try to change every day.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to revise or amend text is to alter it.

clue.text: Awesome trim

explanation.definitionFit: Both are senses of the word: slang for excellent, and tidy or well kept.

clue.text: Struggled to get words out when rushed to grasp line, say

indicators.note: to grasp means the rushing word holds the following pieces inside it

parts.note: sped means rushed
to utter is to say

explanation.surface: An actor in a hurry fumbled a line.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: someone who stammered and choked out speech spoke with difficulty.

clue.text: That woman had somewhere to keep garden tools

parts.note: she refers to a woman
the contraction 'd stands for had

explanation.surface: A woman owned a place for her garden tools.
explanation.walkthrough: Read the answer as the contraction SHE'D, short for she had.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a small hut at the end of a garden stores spades and mowers.

clue.text: Green tin I'd stirred, food added

indicators.note: stirred means the letters are mixed up like a pot's contents

explanation.surface: A cook stirs a green tin's contents and adds food.
explanation.definitionFit: A component put into a recipe is food added to the mixture.
